title: Lanterns for the Glass Bridge
story: Gaudrelle the Pane Shrieker screeches through the dark and cracks the glass bridge — but she cannot bear light. The bridge is 250 meters long, and each lantern Mr 6 hangs lights a stretch of 18 meters. The village has only a pile of lanterns and one very short night.
question: How many lanterns are needed to light all 250 meters if each covers 18 meters?
hint: Divide 250 by 18 — then think about whether a leftover stretch still needs a whole lantern.
victory: Thirteen lanterns would have left four dark meters — exactly where Gaudrelle liked to shriek. Mr 6 hung a fourteenth, and the Pane Shrieker fled with her ears ringing in rainbow light.
imagePrompt: A numeral-six knight hanging glowing lanterns along a translucent glass bridge over a misty chasm while a shrill winged shrieker recoils from the spreading light.
